vision.name: Black Absorption Drill
vision.text:
(Limit 1 per deck. If this card is destroyed from your Life Deck, choose 2 cards in your opponent's discard pile, banish them and gain 2 stages. If this card is discarded from your hand, Rejuvenate the bottom 2 cards of your discard pile.)
[Continuous]: Whenever you discard, destroy, or banish cards from your opponent's Life Deck from a non-damage effect, you may place a Styled card from either player's discard pile on top of its owner's Life Deck.
vision.note: landscape Drill layout; no Endurance badge
